name: Mangroomer

lead: Mangroomer is a Santa Monica, California brand known for its extended-handle electric back shavers, and it also sells body groomers, nose and ear trimmers and wipes. The back shaver lets a user shave areas he cannot easily reach.

The appearance payoff is smooth skin on the back and shoulders, which bodybuilders and men who go shirtless value. Support in the sources is anecdotal: gym-forum members describe it as doing "a pretty nice job".

paras: Users run the shaver over the back with the long handle, usually dry or per the model. The brand lists replacing blades about every six months. Forum users typically shave before summer or contests, and the effect lasts until regrowth.
As with any shaver, skin irritation, nicks and ingrown hairs are possible. The brand and forum posts do not report serious harms. Hair returns, so results are temporary.

angle.text: The extended handle lets a person shave their own back hair, producing a smooth finish for the beach, gym or physique contests. Hair regrows, so it is repeated.

lead: Mangroomer is a brand of electric back hair shavers with a long, adjustable handle, now based in Santa Monica, California. The company says it has 20 years of R&D behind its back shavers. [1]
Its range also includes body groomers, nose and ear trimmers, haircut kits and wipes. Back shavers on its site are listed at about $130 to $200 and body groomers at $40 to $100. [1]

Gym forums have mentioned it since at least 2009. One T Nation member who shaved his back with one called $40 "expensive" but said it "did a pretty nice job". [2] A 2010 contest competitor posting there said he was doing marketing for the brand. [3]

paras: Back shavers have an extended-reach handle and flexible, shock-absorbing heads. Body groomers are rechargeable and sold in wet or dry versions. [1]
Forum threads on removing back hair mention Mangroomer as an easier-to-reach option. [4][5] Bodybuilders shave before competitions and summer. [2][3]
